narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Twelve goes into twenty four point eight six about two point zero seven times.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>But one point two goes into twenty four about twenty times.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Both numbers had to be multiplied by ten, not only the divisor.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Make the divisor a counting number by moving the point in both numbers together.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>If a remainder comes back, the digits after it will repeat for ever.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor; the words make the divisor a counting number, watch the remainders appear

old_misconception.wrong_move: A common slip divides twenty four point eight six by twelve without moving its point, and gets about two point zero seven. The answer is ten times too small.
